requirement.description: The WebDAV error handling in HttpCli is not correctly returning XML responses for certain error codes (401, 403, 404, 405) when the mode is a WebDAV method. Instead of returning proper XML error responses, it's returning HTML responses with text/html Content-Type.
requirement.contract: When a WebDAV method encounters an error with code 401, 403, 404, or 405, the HttpCli should return an XML error response with Content-Type: application/xml; charset=utf-8 instead of HTML response with text/html Content-Type.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_webdav.py::TestHttpCli::test - should pass without Content-Type mismatch errors

requirement.description: When handling thumbnail requests (with 'th' parameter), the tx_404 method is incorrectly calling tx_svg with error code text that doesn't match expected format, resulting in wrong error codes in SVG output.
requirement.contract: When handling thumbnail requests (with 'th' parameter) and a 403 error occurs, the tx_404 method should call tx_svg with "e403" instead of "e404" to produce the correct SVG error message.
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_dots.py::TestDots::test_dk_fk - should pass with expected e403 error code in SVG output

requirement.description: The tx_404 method does not properly distinguish between 403 and 404 errors when handling thumbnail requests, causing incorrect SVG error codes to be generated.
requirement.contract: When handling thumbnail requests with 'th' parameter, the tx_404 method should correctly identify if it's a 403 error and use "e403" in the SVG filename instead of "e404".
requirement.acceptance: tests/test_dots.py::TestDots::test_dk_fk - should pass with expected e403 error code in SVG output
